_comment: POSTURE C ON THE FIELD, ARM 2b — GPS + GALILEO (Q-FAMILY ONLY), 20 min.
Supersedes _pc305_gg_tri_slant_20m, which withheld ALL epochs.  Root cause
MEASURED (5-ep estimability dump, runs/pc305_gg_tri_slant_5ep_estdump,
logs/network_estimability.csv): n_below 22 = 2 declared clock gauges
(CLK|G* 1/sqrt(33), CLK|E* 1/sqrt(23)) + ~20 UNDECLARED per-satellite
X-family directions — CB|E|C5X = PB|E|L5X and CB|E|C7X = PB|E|L7X moving
together with band weights 1 : 1.793 : 1.703 = the mu (iono) coefficients.
That is Odijk rd 3b PER CHANNEL FAMILY: the roster partitions cleanly
(187 stations pure Q, 113 pure X, ZERO bridging), so the (C1C,C5Q) IF+GF
pins never touch an X-station observation and the X-family per-sat bias
lump is absorbed by the X stations' free slant iono.  drop-and-heal
correctly failed (152 cols tried, 0 healed — a ~20-dim null space has no
droppable column).
THIS ARM: Galileo Q family only (C1C/C5Q/C7Q).  The X states vanish and
the undeclared null space with them.  Coverage cost, measured on the
roster: E rows come from 187 stations; the 113 X-family stations still
contribute GPS fully.  GPS keeps its C5Q+C5X whitelist — GPS X channels
are bridged (every GPS station tracks the pinned C1C/C2W), measured clean
in the 10-ep arm.
THE CORRECT FIX (owed, SPEC card): per-family satellite IF+GF datum in
buildCodeBiasDatumRows when the observing station set of a constellation
partitions by channel family — pins on (C1X,C5X) beside (C1C,C5Q), third
band per family carries the family's modernized DCB.  Until that card
lands, X-family Galileo is NOT runnable in posture C.
EXPECTED: declared_dim 2 = n_below 2 at default tolerance; E datum
inventory = per-sat IF+GF pins with 0 'no third band' (full fleet is
triple); eq34 chains COMPLETE for E L1C/L5Q/L7Q; E B-records pinned-pair
~datum-exact with C7Q carrying metre-scale content; watch E36-class
few-station sats for marginal rank dips (weakest real measured 5.4e-02,
2.5 decades above cutoff — should hold).
Still ignition (40 ep): structural + same-window ratios only.
2026-08-13 — EWL DISARM ATTEMPTED AND REVERTED THE SAME DAY.  Kept as a
record so nobody retries it without reading the three reasons it failed.
REASON 3 (decisive, found last): the disarm made this chain UNLOADABLE.
`mw_wl.uwl_enable` is inherited TRUE, and GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:6301-6307
is `if (mw.uwl_enable && !mw.ewl_enable) { log->error(...); return false; }`
— a HARD ERROR that aborts loadFromJson.  The UWL top tier IS the EWL
machinery run on the per-constellation lane-tier pair, so ewl cannot be
disarmed alone.  Disarming BOTH would also have cost the UWL lane statistic
(measured 207765/209431 = 99.2 % FFR over the 4 h arm).
REASON 2: the measurement went the other way.  Single-knob 60-sta A/B
(_simnet60_tri_slant_trio_480_noewl vs …_trio_480, 480 ep, identical trace
population) — ewl OFF was WORSE on 4 of 5 truth-graded channels: rxDCB
58.3 vs 46.1 m, rxCLK 1121 vs 857 m, ZWD 396 vs 196 m, DD 3779 vs 2304 cyc.
Both arms were catastrophically diverged, so read this as 'ewl is not the
lever', NOT as 'ewl is beneficial'.
REASON 1: the rationale below is FALSIFIED.  The carry exclusion is real in
code but is not the divergence driver.
THE ORIGINAL (now-falsified) RATIONALE, kept verbatim:  `mw_wl.ewl_enable`
was inherited unbroken from the vertical-iono FT63 lineage this chain
extends (set at _ft63_24h_conv.json:744).  It is NOT inert here:
ApplicationNetwork.cpp:667 forms
ewl_carry_exclude = carry_invariant && nmw.ewl_enable
and posture C arms carry_invariant, so the pair is live and EXCLUDES the
third band's DD ambiguity chords from the invariant carry.  Under Odijk
Sect 5.1 / Table 7 the third band is precisely the band carrying the ONLY
estimable code bias in a slant network (rd 3b makes j=1,2 code biases
inestimable), so the exclusion removes carry from the one band the posture
exists to determine.  The exclusion is unlogged and uncountered.
Disarmed HERE, not at the FT63 root: that root has ~254 transitive
descendants and a one-line edit there silently re-postures every
63-station arm in the tree.  Nested objects deep-merge under `extends`
(GnssConfigJsonHelpers.hpp:63) — only ARRAYS replace — so this override
clears ewl_enable without dropping sibling mw_wl keys.
Loader note: ewl_enable REQUIRES carry_invariant (GnssConfigLoadNetwork
.cpp:6193); turning ewl OFF with carry_invariant ON is legal and quiet.
⚠️ 2026-08-13, SAME DAY — THE RATIONALE ABOVE IS FALSIFIED ON THE SIM.
The single-knob 60-sta A/B (_simnet60_tri_slant_trio_480_noewl vs
…_trio_480, 480 ep, same fixture/window/build, QC telemetry identical)
shows disarming EWL does NOT fix the trio runaway and degrades every
graded channel: settled per-band med|e| 2280 → 3700 cyc (+62%), WL 119 →
140 cyc, full-window EWL round(e)=0 32.4% → 25.7%.  The carry exclusion is
REAL in code but is NOT the divergence driver.
This override is therefore UNJUSTIFIED BY EVIDENCE and is a REVERT
CANDIDATE.  It is retained only because it was explicitly requested; the
sim contrast is between two already-diverged states and the field arm is a
DIFFERENT posture (no seed_round; lanes read 99.2% FFR on the frac-only
instrument), so this is not proof the disarm harms the field either — the
REASON for it is simply gone.  Delete the mw_wl block below to revert.
